owner.title: Your replay
owner.deleteDescription: The file and its analysis are removed for good.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.

errors.rateLimited: Too many requests, try again in a minute.

scoreboard.note: Post-battle results from the replay file.

timeline.title: Battle flow
timeline.chartLabel: Vehicles alive in each team over the battle
timeline.note: Built from when vehicles were destroyed. The replay does not record damage over time.
timeline.emptyDescription: The replay has no post-battle results, usually because recording stopped early.

heatmap.title: Heatmap
heatmap.noArenaDescription: The replay has no map info.
heatmap.samples: {samples, plural, one {# position} other {# positions}} from all replays
heatmap.empty: No data for this selection yet

kolobanov.label: Kolobanov
kolobanov.rule: A win where the recorder was the last one alive on the team, with at least {minEnemiesAlive} enemies alive when the last ally fell.

comeback.label: Comeback
comeback.rule: A win after the recorder's team was down by {minDeficit} or more vehicles alive.

raider.label: Raider
raider.rule: A win by capturing the enemy base, with at least {minCapturePoints} capture points from the recorder.

highCaliber.label: High Caliber
highCaliber.rule: The recorder dealt the most damage in the battle and at least {minShareOfEnemyHealth, number, percent} of the enemy team's total hit points.

warrior.label: Warrior
warrior.rule: The recorder destroyed at least {minFrags} vehicles and no ally destroyed more.
